BatchCheckSession.description_en: This API is used to check suspected abnormal sessions.
BatchCheckSession.description_zh: 此接口用于检查疑似异常会话

CancelReserveTask.description_en: Cancel the specified container reservation job
CancelReserveTask.description_zh: 取消指定的容器预定任务

CreateAdaptation.description_en: Create an adaptation request for an application version
CreateAdaptation.description_zh: 为某个应用版本创建适配请求

CreateAppSession.description_en: Create an application session and start an application process, then return the session information
CreateAppSession.description_zh: 创建应用会话，并启动一个应用进程，返回会话信息

CreateAppSessionBatchSync.description_en: You can batch create application sessions. The platform allocates resources and starts multiple processes sequentially
CreateAppSessionBatchSync.description_zh: 批量创建应用会话，平台会按顺序调配资源，启动多个进程

CreateAppSessionSync.description_en: After you create an application session and start the application process, the session information is returned through a message
CreateAppSessionSync.description_zh: 创建应用会话并启动应用进程后，会话信息通过消息返回

CreateAppVersion.description_en: Create a new version for an application
CreateAppVersion.description_zh: 为应用创建一个新版本

CreateCapacityReservation.description_en: Create a container reservation job. The reservation can run containers that support a specified number of sessions, and the reservation result is returned via an HTTP API
CreateCapacityReservation.description_zh: 创建容器预定任务。预定可运行指定会话数量的容器，预定结果通过HTTP接口返回

DeleteAppVersion.description_en: Delete a version of an application

DescribeInstanceStatsInfo.description_en: This API queries statistics information about Graphic Computing Service instances purchased by users, across various dimensions. You can use this API to obtain instance statistics information based on conditions such as Project ID (ProjectId), District ID (DistrictId), and Instance Type (InstanceType). The instance statistics information includes the number of instances in states such as creating, running, O&M, and releasing
DescribeInstanceStatsInfo.description_zh:
此 API 旨在查询不同维度下，用户购买的云渲染实例统计信息。

用户可以通过此接口获取项目（ProjectId）、大区（DistrictId）和实例类型（InstanceType）等条件下的实例统计信息，

实例统计信息中包含: 创建中、运行中、运维中、释放中等状态的实例数量

GetAdaptation.description_en: Query the details of an adaptation request
GetAdaptation.description_zh: 查询某个适配申请的详情

GetApp.description_en: Query the details of a single application
GetApp.description_zh: 查询单个应用的详细信息

GetAppCcu.description_en: Query the details of running sessions.
GetAppCcu.description_zh: 查询运行中会话的详细信息

GetAppVersion.description_en: Query the details of a specific application version.
GetAppVersion.description_zh: 查询某个应用的版本详情

GetReserveTaskDetail.description_en: Query the details of a container reservation job.
GetReserveTaskDetail.description_zh: 查询容器预定任务的详细信息

ListAppSessions.description_en: Query the application session list. Batch queries are supported. Only information about sessions that have not ended can be queried
ListAppSessions.description_zh: 查询应用会话列表，支持批量查询。只支持查询未结束的会话信息

ListAppVersion.description_en: Query the version list of an application.
ListAppVersion.description_zh: 查询某个应用的版本列表

ModifyApp.description_en: Modify the name of an application

ModifyAppVersion.description_en: Modify the version information of an application

ReleaseCapacity.description_en: Release the reserved container. The container is released only when all specified conditions are met simultaneously. The release result is returned through an HTTP API
ReleaseCapacity.description_zh: 释放预定的容器。当符合指定条件且多个条件同时满足时，容器才会被释放。释放结果通过HTTP接口返回

ReleaseCapacityByBatch.description_en: Release the machines in the specified batch. This is typically performed when the dry run fails, to release the machines in the specified batch. The release result is returned via a message
ReleaseCapacityByBatch.description_zh: 释放指定批次的机器。一般是机器预检未通过时，释放指定批次的机器。释放结果通过消息返回

StopAppSession.description_en: Stop an application session. The result of the stop operation will be returned through a message
StopAppSession.description_zh: 停止应用会话，后续停止结果会通过消息返回

StopAppSessionBatch.description_en: Batch stop application sessions. The subsequent stop results are returned through an HTTP API
StopAppSessionBatch.description_zh: 批量停止应用会话。后续停止结果会通过HTTP接口返回
